examples.label: Contact form with a subject picker and message
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-simple-form" site="Global" id="form-contact-us" for={%{}}>

Talk to the team

We answer every message within one business day.

<.component component_name="chelekom-text-field" site="Global" id="contact-full-name" name="full_name" value="" label="Full name" placeholder="Sara Ahmadi" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-email-field" site="Global" id="contact-email" name="email" value="" label="Work email" placeholder="sara@northwind.co" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-native-select" site="Global" id="contact-subject" name="subject" label="What is this about?"> <:option value="sales" selected>Pricing and plans <:option value="support">Technical support <:option value="partnership">Partnership <.component component_name="chelekom-textarea-field" site="Global" id="contact-message" name="message" value="" label="Message" placeholder="Tell us what you need" rows="5" /> <:actions>

We never share your address.

<.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" type="submit" variant="default" color="primary">Send message

examples.label: Sign-in form with a remember-me option
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-simple-form" site="Global" id="form-sign-in" for={%{}}>

Sign in to your account

Use the address you registered with.

<.component component_name="chelekom-email-field" site="Global" id="signin-email" name="email" value="" label="Email address" placeholder="you@example.com" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-password-field" site="Global" id="signin-password" name="password" value="" label="Password" description="At least 12 characters." placeholder="Your password" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-checkbox-field" site="Global" id="signin-remember" name="remember_me" value="true" label="Keep me signed in for 30 days" size="small" label_class="ms-2 text-sm" /> <:actions> Forgot your password? <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" type="submit" variant="default" color="primary">Sign in

examples.label: Support ticket form with category, priority and details
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-simple-form" site="Global" id="form-support-ticket" for={%{}}>

Open a support ticket

The more detail you give us, the faster we can help.

<.component component_name="chelekom-text-field" site="Global" id="ticket-summary" name="summary" value="" label="Short summary" placeholder="Images fail to upload on the media page" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-native-select" site="Global" id="ticket-area" name="area" label="Which area is affected?"> <:option value="" selected>Choose an area <:option value="editor">Page editor <:option value="media">Media library <:option value="billing">Billing and invoices <.component component_name="chelekom-native-select" site="Global" id="ticket-priority" name="priority" label="Priority"> <:option value="low">Low, it can wait <:option value="normal" selected>Normal <:option value="urgent">Urgent, the site is down <.component component_name="chelekom-textarea-field" site="Global" id="ticket-details" name="details" value="" label="What happened?" placeholder="Steps you took, what you expected, what you saw instead" rows="6" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-checkbox-field" site="Global" id="ticket-notify" name="notify_by_email" value="true" checked label="Email me when someone replies" size="small" label_class="ms-2 text-sm" /> <:actions> Back to help centre <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" type="submit" variant="default" color="primary">Submit ticket

<.component component_name="chelekom-simple-form" site="Global" id="form-account-profile" for={%{}}>

Public profile

This is what readers see next to your articles.

<.component component_name="chelekom-text-field" site="Global" id="profile-display-name" name="display_name" value="" label="Display name" placeholder="Sara Ahmadi" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-text-field" site="Global" id="profile-username" name="username" value="" label="Profile address" description="Your page will live at northwind.co/authors/your-handle" placeholder="sara-ahmadi" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-email-field" site="Global" id="profile-contact-email" name="contact_email" value="" label="Contact email" placeholder="sara@northwind.co" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-textarea-field" site="Global" id="profile-bio" name="bio" value="" label="Short bio" description="Around 200 characters works best." rows="3" placeholder="Writes about design systems and slow mornings." /> <:actions> <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" type="button" variant="outline" color="natural">Cancel <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" type="submit" variant="default" color="primary">Save changes
